Swamp concept

What you see

  • Ground: today's mud with patches of a lighter mud, mottled wet mud along the water, wet grass on the drier spots and moss soil on hummocks and under trees. Low hummocks stand one node up.
  • Pools: water sources 1 deep, 2 deep in their middle, on a mud bed; only on flat ground with no lower neighbour, so no water flows. Waterlilies on the open water, reeds rooted in the bed along the bank.
  • Bank: reeds (1–2 high) and cattails right beside the water, moss carpets on the mud.
  • Swamp trees: gravewood's bark and shapes; low and crooked on 3–4 short stilt roots, long almost level limbs, sparse flat leaf pads, hanging moss. Ferns and moss carpets in their shade.

Orbit: drag to turn, right-drag to pan, wheel to zoom. Top: drag to pan, wheel to zoom. Every seed is a new patch from the same rules.

“ART set” is lane ART's swamp set, picked by the user (2026-10-13), with ART's olive tree leaves; “stand-ins” are today's textures, some tinted with a texture modifier (there the olive leaves are a tinted jungle leaf).
